parameters.query:
INSERT INTO customer_facts (contact_id, fact_key, fact_value, confidence, source)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::numeric, $5
WHERE $2 IS NOT NULL AND $3 IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (contact_id, fact_key)
DO UPDATE SET fact_value = EXCLUDED.fact_value, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, source = EXCLUDED.source, updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO lead_scores (contact_id, conversation_id, budget_score, urgency_score, project_type_score, location_score, engagement_score, total_score, status, project_type, estimated_budget, preferred_timeline, project_location, score_reasoning)
VALUES ($1, $2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, $3, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, $4)
ON CONFLICT (contact_id, conversation_id)
DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, score_reasoning = EXCLUDED.score_reasoning, last_calculated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id;
